villages.amenitiesShortDescription: Grand Palm provides the ultimate resort-style experience with a combination of high-end homes by Neal Communities and a rich amenities package. Amenities include pools, a fitness center, volleyball, basketball, playgrounds, trails and much more.
villages.aboutVillageDescription:
Grand Palm is a large neighborhood in Wellen Park developed by Neal Communities, offering single-family homes, villas, and paired villas across various floor plans. It includes a robust amenity package with two clubhouses, multiple pools (with waterslides), a fitness center, tennis and pickleball courts, volleyball, basketball and over 10 miles of trails, making it ideal for families and active residents.  This neighborhood also has planned activities year round - keeping you engaged and making it easy to get to know your neighbors.

The community features lakes and preserves, enhancing its natural appeal, and is located near downtown Wellen Park for easy access to shopping and entertainment. It even has its own island - where you can be secluded in nature.  Its focus on outdoor recreation and social spaces suits a range of lifestyles, from young families to retirees.
villages.villageShortDescription: Grand Palm is a large neighborhood of upscale homes by Neal Communities with a large amenities package that features multiple clubhouses, pools, trails, playgrounds and more for family-friendly living.

builder1.builderSubtitle: Neal Communities is a locally-based builder with deep roots in Southwest Florida, known for crafting thoughtfully designed homes and strong community ties. They are building across multiple Wellen Park neighborhoods including Palmera, Everly, Grand Palm, Boca Royale, Wysteria and Avelina. Their homes emphasize open spaces and natural surroundings.
builder1.builderDescription:
Neal Communities is a family-owned builder with over 50 years of experience in Southwest Florida, renowned for creating thoughtfully designed homes. Their energy-efficient residences boast open floorplans, spacious kitchens, and inviting outdoor living spaces—features designed with modern families in mind.

In Wellen Park, Neal Communities is constructing homes across several villages, including Avelina, Boca Royale, Everly, Grand Palm, Palmera, and Wysteria. Offering a diverse range of home styles and price points, they cater to various lifestyles and budgets, all while maintaining a strong focus on quality construction and customer satisfaction.
builder1.title: Neal

samples.floorPlanDescription: Welcome to the Savannah 2, a stunning 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom single-family home by Neal Communities at Grand Palm. Spanning 2,868 sq. ft., this thoughtfully designed home features an open-concept layout with a spacious Great Room, elegant dining area, gourmet kitchen, and a formal den. The luxurious master suite boasts a recessed ceiling, two walk-in closets, a spa-like soaking tub, a corner shower, and dual vanity sinks. A private guest suite with an en-suite bath and walk-in closet offers comfort and convenience, while a dedicated Tech Space provides room for work, study, or entertainment. Two additional bedrooms accommodate family and guests, with the option to convert one into a versatile club room—perfect for game nights and gatherings. A covered lanai and a generous 3-car garage complete this exceptional home, blending style, comfort, and functionality.

samples.amenitiesShortDescription: Gran Paradiso offers homes in a gated Tuscon-style Wellen Park setting. Amenities include a resort-style pool, fitness center, a yoga studio, tennis courts and more.
samples.aboutVillageDescription:
Gran Paradiso is a gated community in Wellen Park offering a mix of condos, coach homes, villas, and single-family homes with Tuscan-inspired architecture. Spanning over 1,000 acres, it includes a large clubhouse with a resort-style pool, a yoga studio, fitness center, tennis courts, pickleball courts, and a sauna, providing a vacation-like atmosphere.

Located near US 41, residents have easy access to downtown Wellen Park, beaches, and the Atlanta Braves’ CoolToday Park. The neighborhood appeals to families and retirees alike, with its blend of social activities, scenic preserves, and proximity to shopping and dining options.

villages.amenitiesShortDescription: Esplanade at Wellen Park is planned around a resort-style amenity experience, including clubhouse spaces, fitness and wellness offerings, pools, sport courts, dog-friendly areas, community gathering spaces, and concierge-style services.
villages.aboutVillageDescription:
Esplanade at Wellen Park is a gated Taylor Morrison community designed around elevated, resort-style living. The community offers a mix of twin villas and single-family homes, giving buyers options that range from lower-maintenance living to larger, more spacious home designs.

What makes Esplanade stand out is its focus on lifestyle. Rather than simply offering a pool and clubhouse, Esplanade is designed around signature amenities, wellness programming, concierge services, and an active social environment where residents can enjoy fitness, recreation, relaxation, and community events close to home.

The location also gives residents access to the broader Wellen Park lifestyle, including Downtown Wellen, local restaurants, shopping, events, walking and biking trails, and nearby Gulf Coast beaches. For buyers who want newer construction with a more curated, amenity-rich experience, Esplanade is one of the more lifestyle-focused communities in Wellen Park.

samples.floorPlanDescription: Find your oasis in the Argenta floor plan. This 2-story home features 4 bedrooms, 4.5 bathrooms, a 3-car garage and 3,745 square feet. Head through the porch and into an elegant foyer to find two private bedroom suites, each with their own bathrooms. The laundry room nearby adds a touch of convenience. Keep going to find true open-concept living: a casual dining area flows into a spacious great room, kitchen and lanai, an ideal spot to enjoy warm evenings. A customizable flex room lets you personalize your space, while the luxurious primary suite is an at-home haven. Upstairs, find a large loft, additional flex space and a fourth bedroom and bathroom. Or choose a fun game room! When you live at Esplanade, it’s like you’re on vacation every day. Experience inspired living and enjoy an exciting array of resort-style amenities and wellness programs to invigorate the mind, body and spirit.
